Foundryard — the open founder network

# The Founder Network That’s Actually Open.

Foundryard is a social network built for startup founders. Create a profile, discover and connect with founders working on real things, and get honest feedback instead of building in a vacuum. No application, no invite, no closed club.

## Built for Founders Who Build in Public

Three steps to your first real conversation.

1

### Claim your profile

Sign in with Google or GitHub, pick your username, and add your projects: live, MVP, building, or acquired.

2

### Share what you're building

Put your idea or project on your page — where it's at, what it does, and what you're stuck on. No polish required.

3

### Connect and get unstuck

Founders find you by stage and industry. Connect with one click, trade feedback, and keep shipping.

## Why Founders Switch

Your story is scattered across five tools. Bring it under one roof.

Link-in-bio tool LinkedIn profile Closed communities

### The scattered stack

Links in one app, network in another, and the best founder communities locked behind an application. Fragmented branding, zero discoverability, and nowhere to ask for honest help.

### Foundryard

The founders-only network. Discover people by stage, industry, and what they’re building; connect with one click; ask for feedback from founders who’ve been where you are — no closed club, no application process. Your profile, your projects, your people, all in one place.
